description: This file defines the 'Subscription' class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages CRUD operations and other actions related to subscriptions, including handling subscription details, histories, logs, products, options, and status updates. The class interacts heavily with the database and is part of the admin model layer for sale subscriptions.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents subscription management within the Opencart admin sale module, providing methods for CRUD operations, status updates, history tracking, and related data retrieval for subscription entities.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Deletes a subscription record identified by subscription_id, along with its related products, histories, and logs.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining amount for a specific subscription in the database.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Updates the next date for a specific subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByCustomerPaymentId
methods.description: Deletes subscription(s) associated with a specified customer payment ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific subscription, decoding payment and shipping methods from JSON if available.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves subscription data linked to a specific order and product.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscriptions based on various optional filters such as customer, date, status, etc.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscriptions matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsByStoreId
methods.description: Counts total subscriptions associated with a specific store.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts total subscriptions with a specified status.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes subscription product records for a given subscription.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products linked to a subscription.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Gets options associated with a specific subscription and product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Removes options for a given subscription.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history record to a subscription and updates its status.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves paginated history records for a subscription.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history records for a subscription.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts total history records with a specific status.

methods.name: deleteLogs
methods.description: Removes log records for a subscription.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves log entries for a subscription with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogs
methods.description: Counts total log records for a subscription.
